import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

stations = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]
costo_fisso = {"A":35, ...}
capacita = {"A":42, ...}
zone = ["Z1",...,"Z12"]
domanda = {"Z1":8, ...}
tempi = {

ovest = ["A","B","C","D"]

critiche = ["Z3", "Z8", "Z11"]

archi = [(i,j) for i in zone for j in raggiungibili[i]]

m = gp.Model("Rete_emergenza")
m.Params.OutputFlag = 0

y = m.addVars(stations, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y")
x = m.addVars(archi, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")

m.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(costo_fisso[j]*y[j] for j in stations)
    + gp.quicksum(domanda[i]*tempi[i][j]*x[i,j] for i,j in archi),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in stations) == 4, name="quattro_aperte")
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in ovest) >= 1, name="almeno_ovest")
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in est) >= 1, name="almeno_est")

for i in zone:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i,j] for j in raggiungibili[i]) == 1, name=f"assegnazione_{i}")

for j in stations:
    m.addConstr(
        gp.quicksum(domanda[i] * x[i,j] for i in zone if j in raggiungibili[i])
        <= capacita[j] * y[j],
        name=f"capacita_{j}"
    )

for i in critiche:
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(y[j] for j in raggiungibili[i]) >= 2, name=f"backup_{i}")

m.optimize()

status_map = {GRB.OPTIMAL:"OPTIMAL", GRB.INFEASIBLE:"INFEASIBLE", GRB.UNBOUNDED:"UNBOUNDED", GRB.INF_OR_UNBD:"INF_OR_UNBD"}
status_str = status_map.get(m.Status, str(m.Status))

if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    result = {
        "status": status_str,
        "objective": m.ObjVal,
        "variables": {v.VarName: v.X for v in m.getVars()}
    }
else:
    result = {
        "status": status_str,
        "objective": None,
        "variables": {}
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(result))
